description: This file defines the AWS ApplicationDiscoveryServiceClient class, which extends the AwsClient class. It includes method annotations for various AWS Application Discovery Service API methods and promises, indicating that it serves as a client interface for interacting with the AWS Application Discovery Service.

classes.name: ApplicationDiscoveryServiceClient
classes.description: This class provides methods to interact with AWS Application Discovery Service, extending the core AwsClient class and adding service-specific method annotations.

methods.name: associateConfigurationItemsToApplication
methods.description: Associates configuration items to an application.

methods.name: disassociateConfigurationItemsFromApplication
methods.description: Disassociates configuration items from an application.

methods.name: startBatchDeleteConfigurationTask
methods.description: Starts batch delete of configuration tasks.

methods.name: startDataCollectionByAgentIds
methods.description: Starts data collection by agent IDs.

methods.name: stopDataCollectionByAgentIds
methods.description: Stops data collection by agent IDs.
